evidence.quote: During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after reaching a projected $650 billion in 2026 .
evidence.one_line: Nvidia management forecast hyperscaler spending above $1 trillion in calendar 2027, after projected spending of $650 billion in calendar 2026.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia management, as reported by the author

evidence.quote: For the rest of this year, they expect 82% growth. For 2027, that figure rises to 41%.
evidence.one_line: Wall Street analysts expect Nvidia growth of 82% for the rest of 2026 and 41% for 2027; the passage does not specify the metric or the period basis.
evidence.speaker: The author, reporting Wall Street analysts' expectations

evidence.quote: For fiscal 2028, ending January 2028, the average analyst projects $12.76 in earnings per share.
evidence.one_line: The average analyst projects Nvidia fiscal 2028 earnings per share of $12.76, for the fiscal year ending January 2028.
evidence.speaker: The author, reporting the average analyst estimate

evidence.quote: If we use that figure and value the stock at a reasonable earnings multiple of 25, the projected share price at the end of fiscal 2028 is $319.
evidence.one_line: The author estimates Nvidia shares could be $319 at the end of fiscal 2028, using $12.76 EPS and a 25-times earnings multiple.
evidence.speaker: The author

evidence.quote: As a result, I think the stock could easily reach $300 per share sometime in late 2027.
evidence.one_line: The author forecasts that Nvidia shares could reach $300 sometime in late 2027.
evidence.speaker: The author
